Easy Access to the Original TopDom 0.0.1 and 0.0.2 Implementations

Source: R/legacy.R
legacy.Rd

Easy Access to the Original TopDom 0.0.1 and 0.0.2 Implementations

legacy(version = c("0.0.1", "0.0.2"))

Arguments

version

A version string.

Value

An environment containing the legacy TopDom API.

Examples
